subject: Gap mitigation endorsement request for SOC 2 Type II (report period through 2024-12-31)
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@zephyrus.ai>
To: tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@zephyrus.ai
Date: 2027-05-30T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: gap mitigation endorsement and SOC 2 artifacts

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Zephyrus is advancing through procurement and our InfoSec team needs a short formal confirmation to cover the period after Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report end date. Our vendor risk questionnaire lists the report period as ending 2024-12-31; procurement requires a one-page management endorsement or bridge-style letter that: (1) confirms there have been no compensating control degradations since the report period end, (2) flags any material control changes, and (3) calls out the date of the last assessment and whether there are scheduled audits in the next 12 months.

Can you provide:
- A bridge/endorsement letter or management assertion (PDF) we can attach to our SIG/assessment?
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (if publicly shareable) or a secure link to download?
- Any targeted evidence (policy snapshots, control change logs) showing there have been no material regressions since 2024-12-31.

Timing: we have a procurement committee on 2027-06-03 and would appreciate materials by end-of-day 2027-05-31 PT. If you need a standard template, I can share ours.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Security Program Manager
Zephyrus AI
Attachment: zephyrus-sig-request.xlsx (spreadsheet of questionnaire items)

Tessa / Neha — legal has reviewed Zephyrus’s request. We are comfortable providing a short Gap Mitigation Endorsement (one page) with the following constraints:

- Language will be a management representation (not an auditor attestation).
- We will confirm there were no material degradations to the control environment since 2024-12-31 to the best of management’s knowledge and subject to the definitions below.
- We will disclose material changes to security architecture or outsourced provider relationships (if any).
- We will include report metadata (report period, date issued) and note next scheduled audit window (we have a planned annual cycle for 2027 but dates TBD).
- Redactions: we will redact sensitive tenant-specific data and any internal vendor pricing or contract IDs.

Neha — please assemble the artifacts: final SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), an internal change-log excerpt for security controls since 2024-12-31, and the summary statement for the endorsement. We’ll attach the endorsement PDF and the SOC 2 report to the outbound reply to Zephyrus.

Marissa Cole
General Counsel (interim)
Redwood Inference
